task: A stall sold 3 jars of jam at 4 dollars each, 5 loaves at 3 dollars each, and 2 tins of tea at 7 dollars each. Create sales.csv with columns item,revenue and one data row per item, highest revenue first. Use jam, bread, tea as the item names respectively. Print the total revenue as a single integer.
name: sales.csv

task: Three bus stops reported their waiting passengers: Pine 4, Lake 11, Hill 3. Only stops with fewer than 5 passengers need the minibus. Create shuttle.json as a JSON object whose keys are the selected stop names and whose values are the passenger counts. Print the number of passengers the minibus should pick up as a single integer.
name: shuttle.json

task: Three delivery addresses have open parcels: 'Dock, West' has 8, 'Canal Road' has 3, and 'Oak Lane' has 6. Create parcels.csv with columns address,count. Put addresses with at least 5 open parcels in the file, sorted by count ascending. Preserve each address exactly. Print the total open parcels for the selected addresses as a single integer.
name: parcels.csv
